name: drawin-mobile
description: Drawin AI Android app — the full router (Node server + dashboard) running standalone on-device via nodejs-mobile.

scripts.build:all: npm run bundle:server && npm run stage:node && npm run prepare:web
scripts.cap:add: cap add android && npm run patch:android
scripts.sync: npm run fetch:vendor && npm run build:all && cap sync android && npm run patch:android && npm run stage:android && npm run stage:native
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && cap run android
